title: Kurs automated docking abort criteria
body: Soyuz Kurs automatic docking shall abort if range-rate exceeds 0.4 m/s at < 100 m, lateral offset > 0.5 m at < 50 m, or attitude error > 3 deg. Crew has manual TORU control authority but shall not engage TORU absent Kurs failure.

title: Soyuz emergency descent (BO ballistic mode)
body: If Soyuz primary descent guidance fails, fall back to ballistic-entry mode (BO). Crew g-load may reach 8-9 g; this is exceptional but survivable. Landing dispersion ~1500 km from nominal site; SAR resources mobilised.
citation: Soyuz Crew Manual; Soyuz TMA-11 incident (2008)

title: Soyuz orbital module leak (2018 incident)
body: Slow leak detected in Soyuz MS-09 orbital module Aug 2018. Crew procedure: 1. Locate leak via stethoscope/listening. 2. Apply Kapton patch + epoxy. 3. Re-pressurize, verify. 4. Document for ground analysis. Ground decided whether to undock or wait.

title: ISS lifeboat capability requirement
body: Each ISS crewmember shall have a Soyuz/Crew Dragon seat available for emergency return at all times. Mission planning ensures the visiting-vehicle docked-time always covers the crew rotation; exceeded coverage requires extending or ending mission.
